result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, but a few layout issues make content look clipped or obscured, especially near the right edge and bottom navigation.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar appears to overlay the feed content. The second “Popular right now” restaurant card is cut off behind the tab bar, so its details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content area so cards can scroll fully above the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: Horizontal carousel items are visibly clipped at the right edge. The “Fastest near you” third card and restaurant name are cut off, and the category row shows a partial empty pill on the far right.
issues.suggestion: Adjust carousel spacing or provide a cleaner peek state so partially visible items look intentional, or avoid showing clipped text/content.

issues.description: The promotional banner’s decorative circular overlays are large and clipped in a way that may look accidental, especially on the right side.
issues.suggestion: Refine the decorative shapes’ size, opacity, or positioning so they read as intentional background artwork.
